behaviors.description: Unexport a document and revoke sandbox file access.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real portal with two exports and a sandbox proven able to read one grant.
behaviors.expected: Unexport removes the ID and FUSE file, denies subsequent sandbox reads and preserves the original file and unrelated document.

behaviors.description: Unexport a document by ID after deleting its origin.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real portal with two exports; target original file is deleted before unexport.
behaviors.expected: ID-based unexport removes only the selected document from listing while unrelated origin and grants survive.

mappings.rationale: A successful sandbox read becomes probe-level denial after unexport; listing excludes its ID and unrelated export remains intact.
The original path is deleted before ID-based unexport and exact listing proves only that document was removed.

surface_assertions.rationale: ID-based removal succeeds with no original file and preserves an unrelated document.
